channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Cid Gomes e Capitão Wagner lideram corrida ao Senado do Ceará
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on July 30, 2026, shows Cid Gomes (PSB) and Capitão Wagner (União Brasil) leading the race for Ceará’s two Senate seats. Cid Gomes has a 36% rejection rate, while Capitão Wagner has 40%. In Scenario 3, Capitão Wagner and Eunício Oliveira (MDB) are technically tied. The survey interviewed 1,002 voters from July 24–28, with a 3-point margin of error and 95% confidence level.

item.title: Multa a Lula por discurso contrasta com tolerância a abusos do clã
item.description: The R$15,000 fine imposed on Lula by the TRE for prematurely mentioning votes contrasts with the tolerance shown by the STF and Minister Alexandre de Moraes toward Bolsonaro clan abuses, such as the use of an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro at the PL convention, which violated TSE resolutions and house arrest restrictions. The defense attempts to shift blame to a 'butler,' but in fact exposes the liability of Flávio Bolsonaro and Valdemar Costa Neto, revealing a strategy to provoke judicial reactions to feed a narrative of political persecution.

item.title: Juliana Brizola e Zucco empatam na disputa pelo governo do RS
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll released on July 30, 2026 shows Juliana Brizola (PDT) and Luciano Zucco (PL) technically tied in the first round of the Rio Grande do Sul gubernatorial race, with 24% and 22% voting intentions, respectively. In a potential runoff, Brizola leads with 35% against Zucco’s 31%. The survey also found that 48% of voters approve of Governor Eduardo Leite’s (PSD) administration, while 42% disapprove.

item.title: PoderData/Aya: Lula é aprovado por 43% e desaprovado por 49%
item.description: Lula has a 43% approval and 49% disapproval rating in the PoderData/Aya poll from July 26–29, 2026, with 8% undecided. Approval dropped 3 points from the prior week (46% to 43%), while disapproval rose from 47% to 49%. On government performance, 44% approve and 50% disapprove, showing a 1-point increase in approval and a 1-point decrease in disapproval.

item.title: Sem voto obrigatório, 22% deixariam de ir às urnas
item.description: 22% of Brazilians would abstain from voting if voting were not mandatory, while 74% say they would still go to the polls even if it were voluntary. Among Lula supporters, 11% would abstain without compulsory voting, compared to 20% of Flávio’s voters, showing greater sensitivity to the change among his base. The survey, conducted by PoderData/Aya from July 26–29, 2026, with 2,400 interviews, has a 2-point margin of error and is registered with the TSE under BR-07845/2026.

item.title: Lula e Flávio têm 49% de rejeição cada um, diz PoderData/Aya
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro each have 49% rejection rates, according to a PoderData/Aya poll from July 2026. Both have solidified bases — 36% of voters say they would only vote for the petista and 31% only for the senator — making rejection reduction the key campaign challenge. For 16% of Brazilians, rejection of other candidates is the decisive factor in their vote choice.

item.title: PoderData/Aya: 62% escolhem candidato pela proposta que defendem
item.description: The PoderData/Aya poll shows that 62% of voters choose their candidate based on the proposals they defend, while 16% vote primarily out of rejection of other candidates. This group of voters motivated by exclusion is seen as crucial in the tight race between Lula and Flávio, as reducing one’s own rejection and winning over these voters could be vital to victory in October.

item.title: Lula tem 46% contra 43% de Flávio no 2º turno, diz PoderData/Aya
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are in a technical tie in a potential runoff with 46% and 43% respectively, within the 2-point margin of error. Lula leads the first round with 41%, followed by Flávio at 35%. The president maintains an advantage among women and in the North, Northeast and Southeast regions, while Flávio leads in the South and Central-West.

item.title: Transparência Internacional vê debate eleitoral sobre corrupção limitado a 'acusações' e lança recomendações a governadores
item.description: Transparency International-Brazil released 40 recommendations to combat corruption in state governments, criticizing electoral debates for limiting themselves to generic accusations. The NGO urges candidates to make concrete commitments on transparency, access to information, and anti-corruption mechanisms, based on the Public Transparency and Governance Index. The report aims to assist transition teams and new governments in setting priorities for the 2027–2030 mandates.

item.title: Genial/Quaest: em cenário de empate técnico no RS, Flávio Bolsonaro tem 32% e Lula, 30%, no 1º turno
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in Rio Grande do Sul, with 32% and 30% respectively in the first round. In a potential runoff, Bolsonaro leads with 40% against Lula's 35%.

item.title: Quaest no RS: Flávio tem 32%, e Lula, 30% das intenções de voto no estado
item.description: The Quaest poll in Rio Grande do Sul shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 32% and Lula (PT) with 30% in presidential voting intentions for 2026, technically tied within the margin of error. In runoff scenarios, Bolsonaro leads Lula 40% to 35%, while Lula leads Caiado (33% to 32%), Renan Santos (34% to 25%), and Zema (35% to 29%). The poll also reveals strong rejection of Lula’s government in the state, with 64% of voters saying he does not deserve a second term.

item.title: Repercussão de notas fiscais trouxe boa e má notícia para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The issuance of invoices by Flávio Bolsonaro's law firm to companies linked to Banco Master triggered negative repercussions, with 37.8% of social media posts accusing corruption or money laundering. However, among those showing clear voting intent, 54.4% expressed support for the senator, indicating limited impact on his electoral base.

item.title: Com ou sem punição?
item.description: A survey of 490 readers found that 80.8% believe Jair Bolsonaro should be punished for using artificial intelligence to address participants at the PL convention that nominated his son Flávio as a presidential candidate. Only 13.9% opposed punishment, while 5.3% suggested he may not have known about the AI use. The result reflects widespread public concern over the ethical use of AI in political contexts.

item.title: Quando o Judiciário reescreve as regras do jogo
item.description: The TSE regulated AI use in 2024 electoral campaigns by requiring transparency but banning deep fakes intended to favor or harm candidacies. Holding Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign accountable for AI use raises concerns about rule predictability, given the tribunal already defined clear permitted limits. The controversy threatens the principle that electoral rules must be known in advance to ensure democratic legitimacy.

item.title: Quando os institutos de pesquisa disputam os mesmos eleitores
item.description: Brazil is experiencing a continuous flow of presidential election polls for 2026, with 69 national surveys conducted between January and June by 19 different institutes, creating an unprecedented environment of frequency and methodological diversity. This context differs from earlier studies based on face-to-face interviews, reflecting a technological transition and the formation of a new electoral polling ecosystem, although institute accuracy remains aligned with international standards.

item.title: Contador de Flávio preso no caso do INSS foi fiscalizado por conselho
item.description: The accountant from the law office of Flávio Bolsonaro, presidential candidate for PL-RJ, was arrested in the INSS embezzlement case and faced two professional council audits for irregularities in client declarations.

item.title: Raquel ganha apoios no PT e reforça voto 'Luquel' da esquerda em Pernambuco
item.description: Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) secured informal endorsements from PT members and other left-wing forces in Pernambuco for her re-election bid, despite the party's official support for rival João Campos (PSB). These endorsements revived the 'Luquel' vote — a blend of Lula and Raquel — signaling an unusual alignment between some PT sympathizers and the governor's campaign.

item.title: Decisăo de Moraes sobre IA de Bolsonaro expőe embate com Nunes Marques
item.description: Alexandre de Moraes' decision regarding the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro used in Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential campaign launch highlights a clash between Moraes' stance and Kassio Nunes Marques' actions at the TSE. The case reveals tensions among justices over the use of technology in political campaigns and the Electoral Court's role in combating misinformation.

item.title: Aliados de Cleitinho já trabalham com saída do Republicanos e veem como improvável reverter decisão sobre candidatura
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo is struggling to reverse the Republicans' decision to block his candidacy for governor of Minas Gerais, with allies considering a party reversal unlikely. Despite publicly maintaining his candidacy and reaching out to PL figures like Nikolas Ferreira and Flávio Bolsonaro, Cleitinho anticipates leaving the party due to irreparable relations. The prolonged indecision has weakened his political image, raising concerns among right-wing allies about his stability and disrupting coalition-building and campaign organization in Minas Gerais.

item.title: O maior temor de Flávio Bolsonaro em relação a uma chapa pura do PL
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign fears running isolated in the 2026 elections, as neither the União Brasil-PP federation nor the Republicans appear willing to form a coalition with the PL. This would leave the senator without strong allies in the presidential race, increasing his electoral vulnerability. Concern is mounting as the deadline for defining tickets and alliances approaches.

item.title: O decreto brasileiro que copia o problema europeu da moderação de conteúdo
item.description: Brazil’s Decree 12.975/2026 copies the European Digital Services Act, particularly Articles 34 and 35 on systemic risk management, adopting a preventive and broadly interpreted approach already criticized in Europe for enabling suppression of legitimate speech and excessive regulatory discretion. The decree integrates this into Brazil’s Civil Rights Framework for the Internet via new Articles 16-B and 16-C, requiring large platforms to assess and mitigate risks such as impacts on civic discourse, public health, and electoral processes — without a fixed list of prohibited content. Critics like Seamus Allen and Marcella Atzori warn this openness may lead to indirect censorship and over-moderation under vague justifications.

item.title: Premiê do Japão agradece apoio de Lula e outros líderes após terremoto
item.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi thanked President Lula and other global leaders for their messages of solidarity following a 7.1 magnitude earthquake in Kumamoto on July 28, which caused 28 deaths and ongoing search-and-rescue efforts. Lula had previously expressed condolences, referencing his meeting with Takaichi at the G7 Summit in Évian. Over 200,000 Brazilians live in Japan.

item.title: Milei decreta expulsão de estrangeiros por discurso antiargentino
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei signed a decree banning entry or ordering expulsion of foreigners who promote hate speech, discrimination, or violence against Argentines based on nationality. The measure followed his remarks in São Paulo calling Lula a 'prisoner' and 'socialist trash', and his accusations that Brazil, Mexico, and the U.S. Democratic Party are funding an 'anti-Argentina campaign'. Brazil summoned Argentine and Brazilian ambassadors for explanations.

item.title: Estratégia cruzada: temendo desgastes, Lula e Flávio calculam ida a debates
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are adopting a 'cross strategy' in electoral debates, where one's participation conditions the other's, with the PL senator avoiding debates if Lula is absent to prevent becoming the sole target of attacks. Both campaigns view debates as both an opportunity to consolidate votes and a risk of amplifying wear and tear, particularly on sensitive issues like the 'rachadinhas' and Flávio's ties to Daniel Vorcaro. Lula leads with 40% in the first round and 48% in the second, according to Datafolha, while Flávio has 32% and 43%, respectively.

item.title: Lula bate o martelo em proposta para educação no plano de governo
item.description: President Lula has defined the expansion of full-time schools as his main education flagship for the 2026 campaign, aiming to universalize the model and build new units. The proposal, coordinated by Camilo Santana and Leonardo Barchini, requires each education network to develop a plan for implementing full-time schools, subject to MEC approval, and seeks to finance it through a project that exempts construction and expansion expenses from fiscal spending limits.

item.title: Bolsonaro se esquiva de Moraes, mas deixa Flávio pendurado
item.description: Bolsonaro avoided responsibility for the AI-generated video used at the PL convention, attributing it to his son Flávio Bolsonaro and PL president Valdemar Costa Neto. However, this tactic exposed Flávio to a clear violation of the TSE's resolution on synthetic content in campaigns, putting his candidacy at risk of severe sanctions from the Electoral Justice.

item.title: As urnas em números
item.description: In Minas Gerais, the second-largest electoral college in Brazil, the winner often mirrors the national outcome due to the state's regional diversity, making it a microcosm of the country. In São Paulo, the largest electoral college, while winning there does not guarantee national victory, a strong lead can be decisive, as seen in 2018 when Bolsonaro led Haddad by 8.1 million votes. By 2022, that lead had shrunk to 2.7 million, reflecting a 5.4 million vote decline in Bolsonaro's favor.

item.title: Resposta de Bolsonaro sobre IA cria dilema para campanha de Flávio
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense denied authorizing the AI-generated video displayed at the PL convention that supports his son Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid. Justice Nunes Marques, rapporteur of the PT's lawsuit, gave the defense 48 hours to clarify whether the ex-president authorized the material, which may constitute a prohibited 'deep fake' under electoral law. If Bolsonaro confirms he did not authorize the video, liability will fall solely on Flávio's campaign, already accused of illegally using AI during the electoral period.

item.title: O risco que Lula corre na eleição
item.description: Lula's advisors believe there is a mistaken conviction within the government that the 2026 election is already won, resulting in no new policy proposals being presented — only a continuation of current programs. This is seen as a strategic error, as no election is guaranteed in advance and the next term will require concrete plans to address specific challenges. The article warns against complacency and stresses the need for a clear vision for the future.

item.title: Zema evita entrar em disputa entre Simões e Aro, mas tentará salvar campanha de sucessor
item.description: Romeu Zema avoided intervening in the dispute between Mateus Simões and Marcelo Aro to prevent being seen as taking sides, choosing instead to focus solely on boosting Simões' campaign. He plans to leverage his political capital across Minas Gerais to offset Simões’ low name recognition (58% unknown per Quaest). Meanwhile, Aro has emerged as a stronger contender for governor, gaining backing from PL, Republicans and the União-PP federation following Cleitinho Azevedo’s withdrawal and Carlos Viana’s inclusion in the governing ticket.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio teme que ação de vídeo com IA de Bolsonaro caia nas mãos de Moraes
item.description: Members of Flávio Bolsonaro’s campaign are concerned that a legal case involving an AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro, shown at the convention that formally nominated him as a 2026 presidential candidate, may be referred to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes. The video is under investigation for potentially violating electoral laws through digital manipulation. The article is subscriber-only.

item.title: STF monitora eleições do Senado e mapeia ‘risco impeachment’ de olho em 2027
item.description: The STF is monitoring election polls and projecting the future composition of the Federal Senate starting in 2027 to assess the risk of impeachment against its justices, amid pressure from Bolsonarist groups. Around 100 impeachment requests against judges are currently pending in the Senate, and the Court is seeking to anticipate future political scenarios. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Aliados criticam falta de diálogo e participação de Flávio para resolver impasses no Rio e em Minas
item.description: Allies criticize Flávio Bolsonaro for lack of dialogue and slowness in political negotiations, particularly in Rio de Janeiro and Minas Gerais, key states for his candidacy. He is accused of delaying important decisions and resisting agreements made by local leaders, causing dissatisfaction even within the PL and the União-PP federation.

item.title: Athletico-PR não vence o Corinthians como visitante desde 2009
item.description: Athletico-PR has not defeated Corinthians as an away team since 2009, with 15 matches resulting in eight losses and seven draws. In Thursday's (30/7) 21st round Brasileirão match at Neo Química Arena, the Furacão aims to end this streak, as Corinthians has never lost to them at home. Athletico-PR sits third with 36 points, Corinthians ninth with 28, both vying for top-table positions in the 2026 season.

item.title: Em meio a "distância segura", Flávio deve ir a convenção de Tarcísio
item.description: Despite allies of Tarcísio de Freitas intending to maintain a 'safe distance' from Flávio Bolsonaro during the electoral campaign, the senator is expected to attend the Republicanos state convention in São Paulo on Saturday (August 1), which will formalize the governor's re-election candidacy. Flávio's participation was confirmed by his pre-campaign team, although Tarcísio's team has not yet officially confirmed his attendance.

item.title: Congresso aprova posse do novo presidente da Colômbia fora da capital
item.description: Colombia's president-elect, Abelardo de la Espriella, will be sworn in on August 7 in Cali, after Congress approved the temporary transfer of presidential functions to the city. The measure passed with 58 votes in favor and 30 against in the Senate, following prior approval in the Chamber of Representatives. Despite opposition from the leftist bloc, which cites added costs and plans protests, the inauguration will take place in a university auditorium, as the use of a military barracks was denied by current President Gustavo Petro, who does not recognize the election results.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro desiste de vaga como suplente de André do Prado
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro withdrew his candidacy as a substitute for André do Prado in the 2026 Senate race after being declared ineligible by the STF for obstruction of justice. He has been self-exiled in the U.S. since February 2025, where he obtained a green card in July 2026, but claims he intends to return to Brazil when conditions allow. His withdrawal leaves the substitute positions to Fernando Fiori de Godoy and Rute Costa, both from PL-SP.

item.title: Alckmin declara “lealdade” a Lula e critica bolsonarismo
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) declared loyalty to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) during the PSB national convention in Brasília, where he was formalized as the re-election candidate on Lula’s ticket. He criticized Jair Bolsonaro’s (PL) government for using state apparatus to hinder voting in the 2022 election runoff, promoting hatred in the name of God, and mishandling the COVID-19 pandemic that caused around 700,000 deaths in Brazil. Alckmin defended democracy as the guardian of freedom and highlighted Lula’s administration’s achievements in employment, income, health, education, and housing.

item.title: Aliados de João veem que Raquel atingiu teto e vão nacionalizar disputa
item.description: Allies of João Campos, the PSB’s pre-candidate for governor of Pernambuco, believe Governor Raquel Lyra (PSD) has reached her ceiling in voter intention polls, with the race currently balanced but slightly in her favor. They expect the dynamics to shift after August 16, when the campaign 'gets real,' and plan to nationalize the race by linking Lyra to Bolsonarism while emphasizing Campos’s record as mayor of Recife. They also dismissed Senate pre-candidate Túlio Gadêlha as politically insignificant for trying to align with Lula’s image.

item.title: Big techs terão de apresentar algoritmo que usam para o TSE
item.description: TSE President Minister Nunes Marques signed an ordinance requiring digital platforms with over 5 million users to submit a 'compliance plan' by August 16, 2026, detailing how they combat disinformation through AI controls, content moderation, bot detection, and transparency in paid advertising. The plan must grant the TSE access to algorithmic information while protecting commercial secrets, and may be overseen by an intensive monitoring committee comprising platform representatives, academics, and regulators.

item.title: João Campos diz que Lula vai a PE no 1º turno e frustra Raquel
item.description: João Campos, the PSB's pre-candidate for governor of Pernambuco, announced that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva will visit the state in the first round of the 2026 elections, frustrating the expectations of Raquel Lyra's campaign, which had hoped for an agreement with Rui Costa to prevent Lula from appearing on the opposition's slate. Campos emphasized that the Lula-Alckmin alliance remains intact and projected victory based on his legacy as mayor of Recife, while also aiming to double the PSB's federal deputies in Congress.

item.title: “Vamos tomar um café”, diz Lula a Moraes após evento no Palácio do Planalto
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva invited Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes for coffee after an event at the Palácio do Planalto, a moment captured by event microphones. The meeting took place following the signing of the 'Pix Alimony Payment' law and days after Argentine President Javier Milei publicly insulted Lula as a 'convict' and Moraes as 'bald trash' during Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign launch. Brazil responded by summoning Argentina’s ambassador for explanations and recalling its own ambassador from Buenos Aires for consultations.

item.title: Nunes Marques pode criar o deepfake do bem
item.description: TSE Minister Nunes Marques has been assigned a PT lawsuit against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over the use of AI in a PL party convention, and must now decide whether to uphold the current ban on deepfakes in campaigns or authorize their use in the 2026 elections, endorsing the Bolsonaro campaign's arguments. The ruling could set a precedent on the ethical or political use of artificial intelligence in Brazilian electoral disputes.

item.title: Lula diz que não perderá eleição mesmo se só errar com Alckmin
item.description: The PSB unanimously approved a coalition with the Brazil of Hope Federation (PT, PV and PC do B) and confirmed Geraldo Alckmin as the vice-presidential candidate on Lula's ticket for the 2026 elections. Lula expressed confidence in winning the first round, even if they make mistakes, and urged activists to use their phones 24/7 to promote government actions and counter what he called a 'narrative war'.

item.title: Eduardo encontra Netanyahu em reunião de líderes evangélicos nos EUA
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at Blair House, the official residence for honored guests of U.S. presidents, during a meeting of evangelical leaders in the United States. He described the encounter as an 'honor,' recalling that his father, Jair Bolsonaro, had also stayed there during his first official visit to the U.S. in March 2019, and reiterated his belief in the alignment between Brazil, the U.S., and Israel as major democracies. The discussion also covered the health of former President Jair Bolsonaro and the 2026 presidential candidacy of his brother, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula chama Milei de “coisa” e diz que não quer Trump como inimigo
item.description: Lula da Silva dismissed Javier Milei's criticisms as 'nonsense' and called him a 'thing', stressing he maintains a state-to-state relationship with Argentina. He also said he does not seek conflict with Donald Trump, preferring to defeat him in the narrative, and noted Brazil denied visas to two U.S. citizens allegedly sent to interfere in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Durigan discute com Lula aperto no arcabouço em 4º mandato e novos gatilhos para restringir despesas
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan is discussing with President Lula a proposal to tighten the fiscal rule framework ahead of a potential fourth term, reducing the annual spending growth cap from the current 2.5% to 1.5%. The measure aims to curb public spending growth and ensure long-term fiscal sustainability.

item.title: Lula confirma Geraldo Alckmin como vice na chapa pela reeleição à Presidência
item.description: President Lula (PT) confirmed Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) as his running mate for re-election during the PSB national convention in Brasília. The ticket will be formalized on August 2 at the PT national convention in São Paulo. Lula praised Alckmin’s loyalty and honesty, criticized Bolsonaro’s handling of the pandemic, and stated he aims to defeat external figures like Trump and Milei through a 'narrative war'.

item.title: Vitória tem dois expulsos em menos de 2 minutos contra o Palmeiras
item.description: In the Vitória vs Palmeiras match of the 20th round of the Brasileirão, Vitória saw two players sent off in under two minutes: defender Cacá was shown a red card at 37' for a foul on Jhon Arias, confirmed by VAR, followed immediately by Luan Cândido for making a robbery gesture with his hands. Palmeiras scored through Maurício at 43' and extended the lead with an own goal by Fabiano Souza, while Flamengo's draw with Internacional left Palmeiras in sole leadership if they hold the win.

item.title: Negociações para advogado de Cid defender Vorcaro são encerradas
item.description: Negotiations for lawyer Cézar Bitencourt, who led Mauro Cid’s plea deal, to defend businessman Daniel Vorcaro were terminated without agreement. Vorcaro, former controller of Banco Master and held in preventive detention by order of Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça, remains represented by Sérgio Leonardo and his law firm. The talks took place at Papudinha but stalled due to the prior rejection of plea deals by the PF and PGR, which were deemed lacking in new evidence.
